jobs.title: Early Careers: Junior C#/SQL Developer & Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Early Careers: Junior C#/ SQL Developer & Data Analytics**

Are you curious about the Insurance industry? Interested in working with a team of experts who are generous with sharing their knowledge, and joining an industry leading, highly inclusive organization? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Montreal office.

**Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.**

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

* Maintaining and enhancing our in‑house applications built primarily with C#, .NET and Microsoft SQL Server, including adding new features, improving usability, and solving bugs raised by users.
* Fulfilling ad‑hoc data requests from colleagues by writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, validate and format information from our systems for business, operational and reporting needs.
* Building and supporting automation solutions (mail merge, Excel macros, C# utilities and SQL Server scripts) that streamline office workflows and improve efficiency.
* Acting as a liaison between business users and Aon IT, helping to translate user requirements into technical requests (e.g., application changes, folder or network access, permission updates).
* Partnering with Aon IT teams to coordinate and test system upgrades, patches and infrastructure changes, ensuring our C#/.NET and SQL Server–based applications remain stable and available with minimal downtime.
* Developing and maintaining business reports (for example, attendance and other key performance or operational reports) using tools such as Crystal Reports, Excel and SQL Server.
* Documenting changes, processes and user guides to support knowledge transfer and provide clear references for both technical teams and non‑technical users.
* Participating in regular team meetings to discuss priorities, review upcoming work, and contribute ideas for improving our systems and processes

**How this opportunity is different**

This role provides an opportunity to observe the full lifecycle of internal tools and applications, from understanding end‑user needs through composing, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will have direct contact with business users, giving you a clear view of how your work improves efficiency and supports critical day‑to‑day operations. You will be working for a business unit supporting high profile clients in the professional services industries, operating in multiple insurance markets (US, UK, Bermuda, Canada) and will have the chance to interact with people from all those locations.

We are a small team, you will gain broad, hands‑on experience across application development, data/reporting, automation and basic infrastructure coordination rather than being limited to a narrow specialization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues in both the business and Aon IT, with opportunities for mentorship, on‑the‑job learning and exposure to enterprise‑grade tools and environments.

The systems you support are important to our business; you will quickly see the impact of your work and be encouraged to propose and implement improvements.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

  

* Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Software engineering, Computer science, Programming specialization, Information technology specialization, Systems Administration, or a relevant field;
* Hands‑on experience with C# (preferably using WPF) in Visual Studio, including building and debugging desktop applications (academic, internship, or professional);
* Understanding of object‑oriented programming and development protocols;
* Solid understanding of SQL, with a strong preference for Microsoft SQL Server (writing queries, joins, basic performance tuning, and simple stored procedures);
* Experience with Microsoft Access for database queries, table design, and relationships
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for basic web pages and user interfaces
* Strong Excel skills (formulas, functions, sorting/filtering)
* Experience integrating C# applications with Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Outlook, Word) programmatically is an asset
* Basic understanding of SharePoint
* Experience with Kentico or Sitecore is an asset
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written;
* French / English bilingualism required due to frequent interactions with clients, colleagues, or partners based in Quebec, other Canadian provinces and/or internationally.
* High discernment and professional presentation skills.

***Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.***

jobs.title: Software Developer Coop
jobs.description:
**À propos de ce poste**

  

**Role description**

As an **intern within the Developer Platform team** , you may contribute to different types of initiatives related to agentic AI, automation, development platforms, and the improvement of software engineering practices, depending on current priorities and the squad you are assigned to. The specific mandate will be confirmed later, but may include:

* Contribute to the exploration, prototyping, or integration of agentic AI solutions that support developers in their day-to-day activities, such as understanding code, automating tasks, analyzing pipelines, or helping resolve issues.
* Participate in improving the developer experience by simplifying the practices, tools, and processes used daily by software teams.
* Contribute to intelligent engineering initiatives, including collecting, analyzing, or visualizing data to better understand engineering performance and identify opportunities for AI-assisted support.
* Help automate recurring operational processes to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and accelerate platform adoption at scale.
* Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, or secure delivery mechanisms that may integrate AI-assisted analysis, recommendation, or automation capabilities.
* Participate in work related to development, integration, deployment, or operations platforms, including cloud, containerized, or automated environments.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product owners to understand team needs and propose practical improvements.
* Explore and prototype solutions that improve the productivity, quality, security, visibility, or actionability of software development teams.

**Candidate profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Passionate** about technology and automation.
* **Curious** , with an interest in learning and experimenting.
* **Proactive** , able to take initiative.
* **Strong in problem-solving** , with a logical and creative approach.

**Desired technical skills:**

* Currently enrolled in a university or college program in software engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* Previous hands-on exposure to software development concepts and at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, PowerShell, or Bash, through coursework, labs, personal projects, or internships.
* Basic practical experience with CI/CD, DevOps, software development platforms, or collaborative development tools such as Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or Jira.
* Some exposure to automation, scripting, integrations, APIs, or operational improvements that reduce manual work and improve developer productivity.
* Exposure to cloud, container, or infrastructure concepts through coursework, labs, personal projects, or previous internships.
* Familiarity, even at an introductory level, with technologies such as Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Copilot, Azure, Artifactory, ArgoCD, or similar platform engineering tools.
* Basic awareness or prior exposure to AI-assisted software development, software quality, cybersecurity, and modern platform engineering practices.

**À propos de CAE**
===================

*À CAE, notre mission est claire : contribuer à rendre le monde plus sécuritaire. Depuis près de 80 ans, nous faisons progresser l’innovation en simulation, en formation et en préparation aux missions afin de soutenir des opérations critiques partout dans le monde. Grâce à des technologies avancées, nous aidons nos clients à travailler plus intelligemment, plus rapidement et de façon plus durable. Joignez‑vous à une organisation guidée par sa raison d’être, où les idées audacieuses sont encouragées, où la collaboration fait avancer les choses et où votre développement alimente notre réussite commune.*

**Type d'emploi**
=================

Étudiant COOp (Fixed Term)

**Égalité des chances et mesures d’adaptation**
===============================================

*CAE s’engage à offrir des chances égales à tous les candidats, sans égard à la race, à la nationalité, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe, à l’identité ou à l’expression de genre, à l’orientation sexuelle, au handicap, à la neurodiversité, au statut d’ancien combattant, à l’âge ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Nous encourageons les personnes qui ne répondent pas à tous les critères à poser leur candidature. Des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables sont offertes au besoin — communiquez avec votre recruteur ou écrivez à* *CAECarrieres‑Careers@cae.com* *.*

**Protection des données**
==========================

Déclaration de confidentialité

*Nous utilisons parfois des outils appuyés par l’IA pour soutenir l’évaluation des candidatures, tout en gardant une prise de décision entièrement humaine. CAE remercie tous les candidats de leur intérêt. Toutefois, seules les personnes dont le profil et l’expérience répondent aux exigences du poste seront contactées.*

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer/ Gen AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Power Platform & GenAI Developer**

Zernam Enterprise Inc. is hiring a skilled Power Platform & GenAI Developer for one of our clients. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, Large Language Models (LLMs), and database integrations to build intelligent business applications, automate workflows, and integrate enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop business applications using Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven Apps.
* Build and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate.
* Develop interactive dashboards and business solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI GPT, Claude, and other LLMs.
* Create AI assistants, chatbots, and AI-powered workflow automation solutions.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize LLM outputs for business use cases.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, Web Services, and Connectors.
* Create and optimize database Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, and SQL Queries.
* Design data models and integrate solutions with SQL Server, Dataverse, SharePoint, and cloud data sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable solutions.
* Ensure security, governance, performance optimization, and best practices across Power Platform and AI implementations.

**Required Skills**

**Microsoft Power Platform**

* Power Apps: Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Power Automate: Flows and Workflow Automation.
* Dataverse.
* Power Platform Administration and Governance.
* Dashboard and Reporting Development.

**Generative AI / AI Development**

* Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* OpenAI GPT Models.
* Anthropic Claude.
* Prompt Engineering.
* LLM Integration and Fine-Tuning Concepts.
* AI Agent Development.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* AI-powered Workflow Automation.

**Database & Integration**

* SQL Server.
* Stored Procedures (SPs).
* Views.
* Database Design and Data Modeling.
* REST APIs.
* JSON/XML.
* API Integration and Development.

**Nice to Have**

* Azure OpenAI Services.
* Azure Functions.
* Logic Apps.
* SharePoint Online.
* Microsoft Fabric.
* Python for AI integrations.
* Azure AI Foundry

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
